title: Richard Hicks appointed Aston Martin reserve driver
caption: Richard Hicks joins Aston Martin as reserve driver
body:
Aston Martin has confirmed the appointment of Australian driver Richard Hicks as its reserve driver. The move adds a new member to the team’s driver roster. Hicks will support the squad alongside its regular drivers.

Richard Hicks, race number 24, currently competes for Schubert Motorsport in the XGT series under a 2024 contract. He has not yet recorded a race result in the league.

Aston Martin competes in the F1 series and sits third in the 2024 constructors' standings with 121 points. The team’s race drivers are Gunner Tai and Jacob Vavro, with Ethan Aston as team principal. Junior drivers Gideon Lettink and Kaizer Navarro have contributed to a season that includes one win and two podiums so far.
